messages:
olivia: quick q — when our endpoints return structured JSON (Content-Type: application/json) should clients treat missing keys the same as keys present with null? seeing some mobile SDKs crash on null arrays. any precedent?

raj: we historically preferred omission for optional fields. null reserved for explicitly nullable fields. i.e. if a property is optional -> omit, if it's explicitly allowed to be null -> include null. see internal contract: <https://redwood.internal/docs/api/response-contract> (section 4.3)

dave: if we switch to omission by default, older clients that expect a key might break. we had a handful of SDKs that do `resp.body.items.length` without checking. could we do a compatibility flag per-customer or return both? :thinking_face:

ciara: possible quick fix is a proxy shim that converts null -> absent for flagged clients. can do per-customer mapping based on api-key metadata. would we prefer that or change server behavior?

raj: i don't love custom headers for semantics. instead i'd prefer content negotiation or explicit schema versioning. clients can send Accept: application/vnd.redwood.v1+json; if they omit it, server returns the new omission-first shape. responses include X-Api-Schema-Version: 2026-03-01 for auditing.

olivia: plan proposal: server default = omit absent optional fields. provide two compatibility knobs: 1) query param `?legacy_nulls=true` (temporary) 2) Accept vendor media-type for older SDKs. ciara — can you implement the proxy shim that honors `legacy_nulls=true` and a per-api-key override? i'll update the SDK tests. :+1:

ciara: yep. i'll add a small middleware in the proxy that checks (order): query param -> api-key override -> Accept header. if legacy_nulls=true transform: replace missing arrays with null and vice-versa as needed. PR with tests in ~2h.

raj: also add a regression test in contract-suite: assertSchemaCompatibility(oldSchema, newResponse) and flag any breaking nullable->absent changes. we should log incidents to tracing with tag `schema.change`.

deploy-bot: NOTE: rolling canary for proxy change to staging at 10:30am PT. will notify on deploy channel when done.

olivia: awesome — thanks all. i'll coordinate SDK bump and announce the contract change in #announcements once ciara's shim is live and tests pass.

ciara: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/proxy/pull/412 — includes unit tests and example curl. example usage:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
     "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?legacy_nulls=true"
```

ciara: also added a short note in the API contract doc about expected semantics and the deprecation timeline for `legacy_nulls`.

olivia: perfect. i'll add a TODO to sunset legacy_nulls in 6 months. :calendar:
